Name: Aesthetic Chickens

[color=#ffd966][size=6][b]☽☆﻿ AESTHETIC CHICKENS MOD ☆☾[/b][/size][/color]

[b]DISCLAIMER: please do not redistribute/steal! if you find this mod anywhere else (i.e. 3DM or stardewvalleymods.net) it was stolen from here. do not support those sites![/b]

[b]
[color=#ffd966]how to install:[/color][/b]

[color=#ffd966]→[/color] download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url] mod
[color=#ffd966]→[/color] unzip the downloaded file
[color=#ffd966]→[/color] navigate to your mods folder
[color=#ffd966]→ [/color]place the [CP] aesthetic chickens file into mods folder

enjoy!
